summary: Implemented the feature: Progress tasks with total=None now render a pulsing bar instead of raising. Changes (uncommitted) in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, tests/test_progress.py, tests/test_bar.py, and CHANGELOG.md. Progress and bar tests pass (47). The full suite has 13 failures in test_syntax and test_traceback that are identical before and after my change. tests/test_pretty.py can't be collected because the shared venv lacks the attr package; I did not install anything. Choices: unknown-total columns show "?" or just the completed count; ProgressBar still defaults total to 100.0, so only an explicit None triggers the pulse.
